en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a group of uniformed men and a few civilians in a long wooden boat crossing a broad river. In the background, on a raised bank behind a stone retaining wall and tree‑covered slope, stands a prominent historic church with steep tiled roofs and a tall baroque or late‑Gothic tower topped by an onion-shaped spire. Around it are several gabled buildings that appear to be part of a walled church precinct or small town. The scene is calm, with a few people on the riverbank and no visible modern infrastructure.
